title: Owari Brief
description: FROZEN CONTRACT. Do not edit. Source of truth is docs/DATA_MODEL.md, section 'The Brief contract'. If this file appears wrong, stop and raise it with Rayhan.

task_name.description: What the user typed in the overlay before recording.

environment.description: Human-readable requirements. Display only — Owari does not provision these.

name.description: snake_case identifier, referenced in step values as {{name}}.

source_column.description: Column in the input rows this maps to.

example.description: The literal value observed in the recording.

intent.description: Plain English, imperative. Rendered to the user in the speedrun view.

target.description: SEMANTIC ONLY. Coordinates are forbidden — additionalProperties false rejects any x or y field.

role.description: Accessibility role, e.g. button, entry, menu item. Empty string for press_key and hotkey.

name.description: Accessible name to match. Empty string for press_key and hotkey.

value.description: Text to enter, or the key for press_key/hotkey. Null for actions taking no value. May contain {{variable}} references.

condition.description: Optional. Omit entirely on unconditional steps.

if.description: Plain English predicate evaluated against the current screen.

confidence.description: Below 0.7 renders with a visible uncertainty marker.

pruned.description: Dead-ends, backtracks and corrections excluded from steps. Required, may be empty.

reason.description: Plain English. Rendered struck-through in the speedrun view.
